The camera pushes in extremely slowly. At about 00:02 it glides smoothly toward <Subject 1>'s left front, foregrounding his clear half-body casting gesture while the background keeps <Subject 2>'s full body in frame; <Subject 1>'s fingertip taps forward and several golden light-chains engraved with Sanskrit shoot through the foreground at <Subject 2>, who flips his wrist and spins a silver-white staff-flower to smash them; chains and staff-shadow collide at frame center, scattering fine golden sparks. At about 00:04 the camera glides right across the collision center and settles at <Subject 2>'s right front, foregrounding his clear half-body as he leaps half an inch and sweeps the staff wrapped in crimson samadhi fire, fire waves rolling toward the lens; the background keeps <Subject 1>'s full-body golden silhouette as he presses both palms together and a circular buddha-light shield unfolds before him; the fire waves crash into the shield and burst into sky-filling sparks while <Subject 1> remains utterly unmoved. The shot ends mid-crash with sparks scattering on the shield, both subjects visible.

A low buddhist hum and howling mountain wind under the opening; a sharp air-rending whistle as the chains launch; crisp spell-collision chinks; a roaring fire rush as the staff sweeps; a deep shield-tremor thud at the crash.
